{"sql":"SELECT
  variant,
  COUNT(*) AS n_subjects,
  AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS conversion_rate_14d,
  AVG(margin_60d_eur) AS avg_margin_60d_eur,
  AVG(CASE WHEN redeemed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS redemption_rate,
  SUM(bonus_cost_eur) AS total_bonus_cost_eur
FROM fct_experiment_users
WHERE experiment_id = 'TOPUP10'
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant;","rationale":"Compare the €10-bonus and control arms on the primary 14-day conversion outcome and the 60-day net-margin guardrail before deciding whether to roll out."}
